caption: The drawing depicts a scene set in a natural landscape with two human figures in the center. The central left figure is a woman wearing a long, bright red dress and a white cap, and she is seated holding a distaff and spindle. To her right, a man stands dressed in brown clothing with a hat, carrying a bundle over his shoulder and holding a walking stick. In the background, there are trees with green foliage and brown trunks, as well as a red and brown house with a thatched roof to the left. Birds, including a large parrot and three smaller birds, are perched or flying among the trees. The sky above is filled with swirling red and gray clouds. On the ground, there are two dogs, one standing on the left in dark brown and one lying on the right in white. In the central foreground, there is a rectangular object resembling a trough, colored in a light beige, with plants and foliage scattered nearby in shades of green and blue. The overall composition uses a palette of reds, browns, blues, greens, and beige.
